title: Chapter 327: The Zerg And Protoss Joint Army
content:
Chapter 327: The Zerg And Protoss Joint Army

A large number of six-star Zerg scorpions in the allied forces of the Zerg and Gods continued to expand the plague coverage area. All the Snow Demon Clan troops that entered the plague coverage area became lambs to be slaughtered.

The main offensive forces of the Zerg and Protoss coalition will not attack the plague coverage area.

A large number of one-star Zerg flying dragons that had just retreated because the ice magic of the Snow Demon Clan army was too strong, led by the Arbiter of the Gods, rushed towards the plague-covered area and attacked the Snow Demon Clan army infected by the plague.

Tens of millions of Zerg flying dragons sprayed biological bombs, blowing up the Snow Demon Clan army that had almost lost its combat power, defense and vitality, and completely disappeared.

The combined forces of the Zerg and Gods used all their strength except for the seven-star powerhouse who did not take action.

The parasitic control of the Zerg Queen was ineffective against the Snow Demon Clan, but it was effective against other flesh-and-blood races. A large number of armies of races affiliated with the Snow Demon Clan rebelled without warning, giving the Snow Demon Clan a fatal counterattack.

For normal races such as the Snow Demon Clan that are not completely controlled by faith, the rebellion of their subordinates is the most unacceptable. As soon as they discovered that many of their affiliated race armies were rebelling, they immediately created a barrier with all the affiliated race armies and began to force Make all subordinate races launch desperate attacks.

Although the soldiers in the armies of the affiliated races were controlled by their beliefs, their IQs were not compromised, and they were still aware of the Snow Demon Clan's wariness against them.

It's just that the subordinate race is, to put it bluntly, the slave race of the Snow Demon Clan, and they can only obey orders and die.

Under the control of the Zerg Queen, more and more subsidiary races of the Snow Demon Clan rebelled and launched attacks on the Snow Demon Clan.

"This is the enemy's control method, not a rebellion of the subordinate race!"

"So what if we know it's the enemy's control method? The enemy seems to be unable to control our race. We can only isolate the armies of the affiliated races!"

“Only in this way can losses be minimized!”

"..."

The Snow Demon Clan also understands the reasons for the rebellion of the subordinate races, but there is no way to solve it and can only deal with it simply.

The allied forces of the Zerg and Gods used all their weapons and tactics to eliminate the Snow Demon Clan army with extremely high efficiency.

The Snow Demon Clan army also uses various methods frequently to force the enemy out of the invisible state in order to change the situation of being passively beaten. Unfortunately, they cannot force the Zerg and God Clan coalition forces out of the invisible state without destroying all the Protoss Arbiters. .

The large-scale ice battlefield magic of the Snow Demon Clan can harm the allied forces of the Zerg and Gods, but it cannot break the invisibility blessing provided by the Gods' Judger.

The Snow Demon Tribe cannot see the enemy and can only blindly use large-scale battlefield magic based on the source of the attack. The attack efficiency is extremely low and it is almost impossible to reduce the number of the Zerg and Protoss coalition forces.

The scale of this battle was very large, and it lasted until dark. The Snow Demon Tribe gave up a large number of its troops and retreated on its own initiative.

The allied forces of the Zerg and Gods did not cease fighting because of darkness. They continued to ignore the strange interference and wiped out all the troops abandoned by the Snow Demon Clan.

At night in the northern main theater, the same strange things appeared. The battle between the Zerg and God tribes to eliminate the Snow Demon army attracted a large number of strange people, and strange celestial phenomena began to appear.

However, at this time, the Zerg and Protoss coalition forces did not withdraw to the area protected by the lords. Instead, a group of high-level Templar warriors disembarked from the Protoss transport plane accompanying the army.

The Zerg and Protoss alliance has the blessing of invisibility, and most of the weirdness cannot be detected, but there are also some special weirdness that can prevent invisibility.

The allied forces of the Zerg and Gods ignored a small number of strange attacks and calmly withdrew from the battlefield.

The seven-star senior divine templar who stayed on the battlefield released a powerful ion storm attack into the strange dense area.

The still white snowfield in the night was suddenly illuminated by countless lightning bolts.

The attack is weird, there is no need to abide by any strong agreement, all powers can be used.

Countless strange things disappeared under the continuous lightning, and the sky in this snowy field began to change color.

The troops of the Snow Demon Clan, who have been far away from the battlefield, are looking at the lightning in the sky from a distance, and the terrifying celestial phenomena that are like the destruction of heaven and earth. Their firm faith cannot stop the fear in their hearts.

"They are deliberately attracting strange people to fight. There have been large-scale changes in the celestial phenomena!"

"They are looking for death!"

"That kind of lightning magic is extremely powerful and is the most restrained against weirdness. They are not necessarily looking for death!"

"This is a demonstration!"

"Which race from the native camp is here this time? Why is it so terrifying?"

"Judging from their ground troops, it is the Zerg who defeated the human race this time!"

"Zerg? Aren't they fighting against humans, demons, and bugbears? Why did they come to our territory?"

"Even the human race was defeated by the Zerg tribe. This Zerg tribe is indeed mysterious. Now it suddenly appears in the hinterland of our tribe. We must deal with it with caution!"

"Immediately send someone to contact the humans, demons, and bugbears to exchange information!"

"Continue to request support from the clan. We must eliminate the Zerg in this area at all costs!"

"..."

The senior officials of the Snow Demon Clan who were responsible for this encirclement and suppression campaign were all observing the movements made by the senior templar warriors of the God Clan.

…

The ion storm of the senior templar of the gods mobilizes all the ion energy within a certain range to launch indiscriminate attacks. Therefore, in a certain area, only one senior templar of the gods needs to launch the ion storm to exert the strongest killing effect. .

The consumption of the Protoss High Templar is mainly related to the range of the ion energy.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

The seven-star Protoss High Templar is fully powered and can trigger an ion storm in a very large range.

In the area where the celestial phenomena are constantly changing, it seems that the lightning attacks are continuous, but in fact there are only a few Protoss High Templars who are attacking, and most of the Protoss High Templars are watching.

As long as this group of seven-star Protoss High Templars take turns to attack, this area can always maintain the state of ion riot.

The ion storm is an ion energy riot. It does not consume ion energy itself. It is a space energy riot, which does not consume the space energy of this space. The damage caused by their riot is just a side effect.

With the seven-star Protoss High Templar, the ion energy riot here will not stop.

No matter how weird it is, no matter how you enter this area, you will be instantly killed by the rioting ion energy.

The battle between the Protoss High Templar and the Weird was maintained in this area and did not expand outward.

The Zerg and Protoss coalition, which had fought for a day, entered a safe area to rest.

The Zerg and Protoss coalition continued to fight with the Snow Demon army, and the Queen and Archon were also constantly collecting information to adjust and test the configuration of the two coalitions.

Through the super-large-scale war that just ended, the adjustment of the two coalitions can temporarily update a version.

The new version of the Zerg and Protoss joint army has optimized the configuration of the arms according to the characteristics of the Snow Demon army, and the combat efficiency will be further improved.

Wu Qing formed several powerful new versions of the joint army at the Zerg and Protoss joint base overnight based on the new version of the Zerg and Protoss joint army.

There are also a large number of troops from the two tribes who rushed to join the existing joint army that was resting overnight. The two sides merged together and could be divided into several new versions of the joint army.

The Snow Demon Clan has a very deep foundation. In the environment of the Northern War Zone, even the alien race is far behind.

In this world, in the extremely cold environment of ice and snow, there was originally no race that could compete with it.

Therefore, now that the Snow Demon Clan has made a little effort to encircle and suppress the Zerg and Protoss, the number of troops dispatched is a sky-high number, and the average strength is not weak. The Zerg Puppies and the Type 3 Zerg Poisonous Ray Scorpions are no match for the main force of the Snow Demon Clan.

The Zerg and Protoss joint army that Wu Qing originally prepared has become a drop in the bucket, and a stronger Zerg and Protoss joint army must be formed in large numbers.

That night, the seven-star Protoss senior templar released an ion storm all night long against the weirdness that surged from the interlayer world.

That night, the Zerg and Protoss joint army that made the Snow Demon Clan army even more frightened increased from one to more than a dozen times, and it still needed to continue to increase its number.

...

It was dawn.

On the snowy plain, the terrifying lightning that flashed all night, and the terrible celestial phenomenon that seemed to destroy the world, finally ended.

All the seven-star Protoss high-level Templars boarded the Protoss transport plane and left.

Countless Snow Demon armies once again set out from the Lord's Sanctuary and attacked the area of the Zerg and Protoss joint base.

In the battles of the previous two days, the Snow Demon army suffered heavy losses in the battles with the Zerg and Protoss joint army, and the Snow Demon army won in most other battles.

The powerful arms of the Snow Demon army took advantage of the favorable environment and instantly launched large-scale battlefield magic ice magic, which was very lethal.

It was difficult for the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to persist under such a large-scale continuous attack.

Fortunately, the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions were able to drill outside the ice layer and avoid various magic attacks, otherwise the losses would be even more severe.

Because of this record, and because the Snow Demons did not think that the Zerg and Protoss would have a large number of powerful and elusive troops, the Snow Demons immediately launched a fierce offensive against the area where the Zerg and Protoss joint base was located at dawn.

Faced with such an attack, Wu Qing asked the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to avoid the battle, and to retreat according to the advantages, or to hide under the ice.

Now there is no need to lose the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions in vain. Many new Zerg and Protoss joint armies with the stealth blessing of the Protoss Arbiter are quietly advancing at high speed in the direction where the Snow Demon army is most concentrated.

The Snow Demon army found that they could no longer see the abominable bugs everywhere today, allowing them to march straight in.

At this marching speed, it will not take much time for these Snow Demon troops to reach the location of the Zerg and Protoss joint base.

Both sides marched at high speed, and the tragic encounter came as expected.

Countless terrifying attacks suddenly appeared out of nowhere, and the arrogant Snow Demon army was stunned. A large number of Snow Demon troops lost a large number of troops in just one encounter without even seeing the enemy.

This is because the Zerg and Protoss combined forces increased the proportion of Protoss arms, and the instantaneous lethality was extremely terrifying.

All Protoss arms, even an unmanned probe for mining, have seven-star strength.

All kinds of seven-star Protoss spacecraft are unmanned or remotely controlled. They can only be regarded as powerful battlefield weapons, not race power.

This is a huge loophole. As long as the Snow Demon Clan does not take the initiative to break the rule that the strong do not take action, Wu Qing will not break it, and will first consume the Snow Demon Clan's foundation in this way.

If the Snow Demon Clan can't help but let the strong take action, the seven-star and eight-star arms of the Zerg and Protoss will let the Snow Demon Clan know what a real strong person is.

As for the powerful strongmen of the Snow Demon Clan, it is estimated that they will not be dispatched until Wu Qing beats them to a dead end. Once the powerful strongmen move, the impact on the development of the clan is very large. The Tianwai people are an example.

If the strong men of the Snow Demon Clan really want to take action, Wu Qing doesn't mind playing with them again.

In the new version of the Zerg and Protoss joint army, the number of Zerg flying dragons and Zerg air guards has been greatly reduced.

To deal with the powerful ice magic attack of the Snow Demon Clan army, the one-star strength of the Zerg flying dragon is very easy to be hurt, and there is no need to participate in such operations.

The Zerg Sky Guard's super long range and powerful attacking ability are basically useless here.

The attack effect of the five-star Zerg Devourer is very good. In addition to normal damage, it can also continuously weaken other enemies in a large range nearby.

The five-star strength of the Zerg Devourer itself makes them not afraid of various ice magics launched by the Snow Demon Army.

The number of powerful auxiliary troops such as the six-star Zerg Scorpion and the six-star Zerg Queen increased. When the battle started, many subordinate races in the Snow Demon Army were controlled by the Zerg Queen and attacked the surrounding Snow Demon Army.

The Snow Demon Army, which was not hit by the main firepower, was quickly covered by the plague area created by the Zerg Scorpion.

The seven-star Protoss reconnaissance aircraft, the seven-star Protoss pirate ship and the seven-star Protoss mothership became the main output besides the Zerg Devourer. The Protoss's technological weapons have a particularly high killing efficiency against the Snow Demon Army.

With the plague area created by the six-star Zerg Scorpion and the weakening effect of the five-star Zerg Devourer attack, the killing efficiency of the Protoss combat spacecraft has been further improved.

The Snow Demon army soon couldn't hold on in the face of the super-strong external attack and the constant rebellion within. Even the enemy couldn't find the Snow Demon army, so they had to choose to retreat.

The choice of the Snow Demon army was surprisingly consistent. As soon as they retreated, they ordered all the subordinate races to rush forward desperately in order to stop the enemy's pursuit.

Unfortunately, they had nowhere to escape. A team of invisible seven-star Protoss reconnaissance aircraft and seven-star Protoss pirate ships quietly cut off their retreat.
